programs.title: Ishqiya
programs.desc: Khalujaan and Babban, two thugs, are on the run from their boss. They seek refuge at an old friend's house but meet Krishna, his widow, instead. Both of them fall for her, oblivious to the fact that Krishna is manipulating them for her own gain.

programs.title: Naqaab
programs.desc: Sophia, a middle-class girl, gets engaged to a millionaire Karan who dearly loves her. But soon she meets the man of her dreams in Vicky, a struggling but ambitious actor. This love triangle causes twists and turns which leave their lives rattled.

programs.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programs.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.
